test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘TONIC’ is written as ‘UPOJDB’, and ‘PRINT’ is written as ‘QSJOUS’. How will ‘SUPER’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : 

 
• (1) is added to each letter's position value.
 
• **last letter's one additional code is added i.e (1) is also subtracted from the position value of the last letter.**

So, 

 
• TONIC is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19c78dded535e1f36def2a9737c2e9394d9c42a9e2eafabc06ddc20e66ac6ee4.png] ​

 
• PRINT is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d69c9dc5ffb332e3dc585612f6535f98417cc80bdfffbf387d2ced259fd08f3d.png] 

Similarly,

 
• SUPER is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39df99c70ed1795d1d53c56e2a51ecdf05e4d61f1a207a4733ae56656b2bc159.png] 

Hence, **"TVQFSQ"** is the correct answer.
